    • groupByProcess

      protected DeploymentMappings groupByProcess(CommandContext commandContext, List<String> ids)
      Puts the deployments that hold versions of the same process (key and tenant) into one group, newest first, and reorders the ids group by group (CIB7-2038). Deleting the latest version of a process moves its start events (timers, message and signal subscriptions) to the previous version; two jobs that delete versions of one process at the same time can leave them on a deleted version. One group is deleted by one job, one deployment after another.
